known_limitations: MDP1 has no authentication, no encryption and no application-level ACK.
Protobuf cannot detect a bit flip that still parses; the oracle catches it in test, a production path would need authenticated transport.
Synthetic data only. Not market data and not usable for trading.
release_blockers: 128/170 cases PASS but 42 are still NOT_RUN; GO requires the matrix to have been executed

ladder.definition: max sustained rate = highest paced target where completed encode+decode+validate reached 95% of target with zero rejections; higher targets are not attempted once a rung fails. The open-loop ceiling is the unpaced rate on this machine and bounds every target.
ladder.lane_note: this ladder measures the in-process Python encode+decode+validate round trip only; it excludes JSON parsing, file I/O, framing and any network path, so it is not an end-to-end platform throughput figure

pacing.note: batches are paced one per tick; the granularity figure is a diagnostic and is not used to decide any verdict

lanes.description: Python typed objects -> Protobuf encode (in memory)
Prebuilt Protobuf bytes -> Python decode + envelope check (in memory)
sim.v1 JSONL -> strict parse -> encode -> .pbstream -> decode + validate
notes: includes JSON parsing, file I/O and framing; not comparable with B1/B2

lanes.description: Malformed/mixed corpus: cost of safely rejecting bad input
notes: 'events' counts frames examined; 'rejected' is the share refused

lanes_not_run.B3: C++ encode in-memory -- measured by the C++ tools, not this runner
lanes_not_run.B4: C++ decode in-memory -- measured by the C++ tools, not this runner
lanes_not_run.B6: C++ encode -> framed TCP -> Python decode -- needs the TCP harness
lanes_not_run.B7: covered by B5 for the Python path

lane_results.measurement_note: each lane's headline figure is the MEDIAN of its trials, with min, max and the spread ratio beside it. A spread ratio well above 1.0 means this machine's rate varies between identical runs, and a single-run number from it should not be quoted

detail.note: C++ reader vs Python reader on identical input
Protobuf output is not canonical, so this is an observation, not an assertion; the oracle is the typed projection (ADR-005)
